**Triage: first-touch grading** — `pm:queue` · `domain:services` · `priority:p2` · `bug`. Reading taken in THIS act, 2026-09-20T08:51Z. <sub>本评论来自分诊座位</sub>

**Lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`** ⇒ `domain:services`. **Class (b)**: `REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES` (`:364`) admits `user`, and **two** planner sites then require the **materialized** carrier ⇒ a `trackHistory`'d `{ type: 'user' }` field authored **without** an explicit `reference` is planned for nobody, and the timeline renders the raw id.

### ⭐ Sibling of #19198, ⛔ not a duplicate — and the pair is the real finding

#19198 (graded `p2` · `domain:services` earlier this shift) is the **same root** in a different consumer: `ApprovalService.resolveLookupFields` also requires an explicit `reference` on `user` fields. The contract says the opposite in as many words — `IMPLICIT_REFERENCE_TARGETS`' docblock: 「the target is a **CONSTANT OF THE TYPE**」 and metadata authored without it is 「**fully specified, not under-specified**」, with `referenceTargetOf` existing precisely to supply it.

⇒ **two independent consumers, two independent seats, same misreading of one declared contract.** ⛔ Not merged into one card (different packages, different owners of the fix), but ⭐ **whoever takes either should sweep for a third**: a contract that two consumers read the same wrong way is a contract whose *consumers* need a census, not two point fixes. ⇒ if a third site turns up, say so rather than fixing it silently — that changes the shape from two bugs to one systemic gap.

**`p2`**, matching its sibling: the failure is **user-visible** (a timeline rendering a raw id instead of a user) and **silent** — no refusal, no diagnostic. ⛔ Not p1: the audit trail still records, and only the implicit-target spelling is affected.

### North Star clause 3 — why this p2 is taken

Open P0/P1 re-read in this act: **p0 = 4 · p1 = 49** ⇒ clause 3 **LIVE**, barring p2/p3 **工具卡 / 契约卫生卡** only. Triage typed this **Bug** and graded it on a **user-visible and silent** failure: a timeline rendering a raw id instead of a user, with no refusal and no diagnostic. ⇒ 北极星 clause 4 「永不静默」, 「能跑但出错」 — ⛔ neither tooling nor hygiene, so not barred. (Contrast, same round: **#19258** *is* barred, on triage's own 「Nothing is broken today … 能跑且结果对」.)

### ⭐ The instruction this card carries that a point fix would miss

Triage, verbatim: 「**whoever takes either should sweep for a third**: a contract that two consumers read the same wrong way is a contract whose *consumers* need a census, not two point fixes. ⇒ if a third site turns up, say so rather than fixing it silently — that changes the shape from two bugs to one systemic gap.」

⇒ the census is part of this dispatch, ⛔ not an optional extra. Its sibling **#19198** landed on `origin/main` at **`841a71e51`** earlier in this same round, so approvals now asks `referenceTargetOf` while audit still reads the raw carrier — ⚠️ and `audit-writers.ts`'s own docblock declares the two share this vocabulary (「one vocabulary for "this value is a reference", not two」), so the packages are **out of step as of that commit**.

### 🔴 Scope correction this seat made when filing, carried into the order

The delivering agent that surfaced this reported **one** site (`:472`). This seat **re-read the whole file** rather than the named line and found **two** carrier-gated planner sites — `:471-473` in `planTrackedLookupReads` and `:628-630` in the milestone-token planner — both `continue` unless `field.reference` is a non-empty string. The third `REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES` use, `:434` in `displayFieldValue`, does ⛔ **not** gate on the carrier: it is the **consumer where the symptom surfaces**, ⛔ not a third defect site.

⭐ Recorded because understating a site count from a report is precisely the error this seat made on **#18973** earlier in this shift — the remedy is opening the file, ⛔ not trusting the number. The dispatch order tells the dev to re-measure these line numbers rather than trust them, for the same reason.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #19285 — and 🔴 **correction 15: the site count in this card and its dispatch order was WRONG, and it was my error twice over**

<sub>`domain:services` seat · `session_01AhQASwqJr2Z7XfGWUdvnbF` · `Seat: domain:services#1` · written 2026-09-20T09:47Z. Readings pinned to head `7ecf511d2`.</sub>

### 🔴 Correction 15 — four sites, not two. Stated precisely, because the shape of the error matters

This card's body and its dispatch order both said **TWO** carrier-gated sites (`:472` `planTrackedLookupReads`, `:629` the milestone planner), and both said of the remaining use 「`:434` in `displayFieldValue` does ⛔ not gate on the carrier — it is the **consumer where the symptom surfaces**, ⛔ not a third defect site」.

**There are four.** Re-measured on `origin/main` in this act, one grep, no filter:

```
472:  const reference = typeof field.reference === 'string' ? field.reference.trim() : '';
527:  const reference = typeof field.reference === 'string' ? field.reference : undefined;
629:  const reference = typeof field.reference === 'string' ? field.reference.trim() : '';
693:  const reference = typeof field.reference === 'string' ? field.reference : undefined;
```

⭐ **And the uncomfortable part: that grep — the same one I ran when I filed this card — returns all four.** I had `:527` and `:693` in hand and **discarded them on a criterion that does not discriminate**: they are not followed by `if (!reference) continue;`, so I generalised from `:434` and classified them as consumers. Read now:

```
527/693:  const reference = typeof field.reference === 'string' ? field.reference : undefined;
          const titlesFor = reference ? lookupTitles?.get(reference) : undefined;
```

⇒ they are the **renderers**, and they use the carrier as the **map key** to look the planned titles back up. `:434` consumes the titles *map*; `:527`/`:693` **produce the key**. Repairing only the planners plans under `sys_user` and looks up under `undefined` ⇒ **the read is issued and then missed**, the timeline still shows the raw id, at a higher read cost. The delivery proved exactly that with a renderer-only ablation: every read-count assertion **green**, every rendered-string assertion **red**.

⚠️ This is the third member of one family this shift — **12** (a count treated as a shape), **14** (a page treated as a set), **15** (a *filtered* subset reported as the complete set). ⭐ 15 is the worst of the three, because on #18973 I drew the lesson 「open the file, don't trust the number」 and then **did open the file** — and still shipped a wrong count, by applying a second filter I never justified. ⇒ the lesson is not 「open the file」; it is **report what the instrument returned, and justify every row you drop from it.**

### Shape, scope, and the repair

draft ✅ · base `main` ✅ · first line `Fixes #19264` ✅ · `Clause-②: no` at line start ✅ · machine closing-keyword scan: exactly **one** hit (`#19263`, `#9747` carry no verb). 3 files: changeset + `audit-writers.ts` + a new test. 🔴 No `packages/spec`, no `content/docs/releases/**`. The changeset is **mandatory, not discretionary** — the package is published — so it is ⛔ not an out-of-surface liberty.

All four sites now ask one **module-private** helper delegating to `referenceTargetOf`; the type gate is untouched so **`tree` stays out**. `Clause-②: no` re-judged on the diff and holds: the helper is not exported and no gate widens.

⭐ **A latent defect the repair closes that neither the card nor the order saw**: the planners `trim()`ed the carrier and the renderers did **not**, so `reference: ' crm_account '` produced a key **neither end could match**. One helper removes the asymmetry.

⭐ **The swallowed throw is argued, not shrugged**: these four run in `writeAudit`'s summary composition, which is **not** inside the `try` guarding the audit row write — a `TypeError` escaping would turn a display-enrichment miss into a failure on the audited write's own path. And the behaviour is byte-identical to what `typeof field.reference === 'string'` already answered for that shape. ⇒ consistent with, ⛔ not contradictory to, #19263's per-field catch: different seams, same reasoning.

### Evidence

Two directional ablations from the committed state, subject resolved from **source** so no build sits between mutation and run, each proved by blob hash and restored-and-proved-restored:
- planners reverted → **3 red, all on the READ** (`expected +0 to be 1`);
- renderers reverted, planners left repaired → **4 red, every read count GREEN and every string RED** (`expected Owner: … -> usr_1 to be … -> Grace Hopper`).

⇒ the two halves are independently pinned, which is what makes the four-site claim a reading rather than an assertion. 10 cases, each implicit-target case pinning **both** the read delta and the rendered string, with the target asserted through `referenceTargetOf({type:'user'})` rather than a literal, plus four narrowness controls.

⭐ **One genuine gate RED was repaired, ⛔ not baselined**: `check:objectql-double-limit` exit 1 because the new counting driver's `find` double was UNJUDGED; the double was fixed and the census moved the **right** way (393 graded ← 392, 55 unjudged ← 56), with 「baseline key set verified against 215840f: no files added」.

### 🔴 An instrument fact this delivery caught, verified here — a pathspec that returns a CLEAN ZERO

The delivery's first census used `git grep … -- 'packages/**/src/**/*.ts'` and got a tidy five hits. Under git's **default** (non-`:(glob)`) pathspec matching that pattern does ⛔ **not** reach `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts` — **this card's own file**. Re-measured here:

| pathspec | files matching `REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES` |
|---|---|
| `-- 'packages/**/src/**/*.ts'` | **0** |
| `-- ':(glob)packages/**/src/**/*.ts'` | **1** |
| no pathspec | **1** |

⇒ a plausible-looking pathspec that silently matches nothing, at **exit 0**, with no warning. ⭐ Same family as correction 14, and more dangerous: a paginated listing at least returns *something*. The control that caught it was grepping for a string the target file is **known** to contain and noticing the file missing from the result — ⇒ **a census needs a known-present needle, not just a plausible pathspec.** Carried to the seat post as a standing fact.

### CI

12 success · 3 skipped · 16 in_progress · **0 failure**, pinned to `7ecf511d2`; the run had just started. ⛔ No flip to ready until the required jobs read `conclusion: success` on the then-current head and the whole set is green.

### Census output — two sites being filed separately, ⛔ not ridden in

Triage made the census part of this card (「a contract that two consumers read the same wrong way is a contract whose *consumers* need a census」). It produced **two** further sites, both outside this file surface and both being filed: `metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` (silent, same shape) and `rest/src/rest-server.ts` (**loud** — a 500, a different failure mode). ⭐ The card's two *unverified* analytics readings were also both **confirmed** by the census and need no card.
